status: PARTIAL_MODEL_WITH_ASSUMPTIONS; no Gate or topology selection

units.bandwidth: decimal GB/s, directed links, full TP-group traffic on each link

assumptions.bandwidthP99Basis: each matching workload scenario planning multiplier, not a measured traffic quantile
assumptions.latencyQuantiles: nearest-rank empirical quantiles across nominal message routes, weighted by collective count; not runtime queueing tails
assumptions.latencyCorners: all parameters low/nominal/high from topology contract; NOT P50/P95/P99

exclusions: background DMA and non-collective NoC traffic
extra D2D forwarding to scale-out ports; ring-cut demand is a lower bound
queueing distributions and runtime latency percentiles
TP16 compute, memory capacity, SRAM feasibility and end-to-end TPS replay

scenarios.notes: 发布点与详细回放场景

mapping.payloadBasis: full-group logical payload and reference-393 class counts from the published K3 operator ledger; payload is not scaled by TP
mapping.lseNICPlacement: one whole head per active NIC up to 8 dies; nicDies[k] from topology contract
mapping.controlPathBasis: TP32 Comm Core control cost held fixed for TP16 as a planning assumption; not a TP16 firmware replay

dieLocal.basis: collective NoC bytes, balanced across dies; not individual NoC link routing

dieToDie.basis: 2 x collective payload crosses the ring cut per collective; not total hop bytes

package.basis: package die-to-die ring cut; same resource as dieToDie, NOT additive

scaleOut.basis: protocol data packets with header, flag and alignment per rank; excludes ACK packets

collective.basis: service class spanning the above resources, NOT an extra physical tier
